notes:
Give agents finer control of your board.

- Select several cards through MCP, add or remove cards from a selection, and read your current selection.
- Keep your view in place while selecting. Agents can focus the view on specific cards when you ask.
- Read original attachments through MCP, including byte chunks for larger files.
- Capture a cropped layout preview of specific cards or a column and its contents.

Scrilo now provides 14 MCP tools. Selection stays temporary and does not enter saves, sync or Undo history. Selection and focus work on the open board; agents must explicitly open another board before using them there.

Reconnect your MCP client after updating to refresh its tool list. Agent access still starts off and can be disabled at any time.
